race.description: Apg Vicbred Super Series 4yo E&G Final (G2)
race.comment: FAIRPLAY (4) has been racking up the wins, putting four together here before leading from one spot wider and going on to take last week's heat at Kilmore. That proved he is up to this level and he should push forward again so can add to the winning streak. THE LAST TRIP (9) is another that made it five wins on the trot when he took advantage of a good draw to lead throughout in his heat. Draws on the back row this time but is unbeaten at this circuit and distance. Last year's Victoria Derby winner FOX DAN (8) hasn't been at his best of late but he has never missed a place either here or at the distance. He draws for a trail so could still be dangerous. SEATHESTARS (2) made a solid return when placed from this barrier in the heats. Fitter and he strikes at 50 per cent here so can be competitive. I AM THE STORM (6) may need some luck from a wide draw but is hard to knock after winning six of his last seven, overcoming back row draws at his last couple.
